title: Color completed route badges from route evidence
summary: Completed table route chips now reuse the normal route badge colors for rows whose displayed label is workflow text but whose evidence still identifies encode, remux, or oversized-encode remux fallback routing.
reason: Completed output rows such as CSV_RERUN were rendering neutral route chips even when row evidence identified the underlying route family, making the Route column harder to scan.
behavior_before: Completed route chips only categorized the visible route label, so workflow labels without remux or encode text rendered as neutral badges.
behavior_after: Completed route chips fall back to explicit route evidence for their color category and Completed-table CSS scopes the normal remux, encode, and remux-fallback backgrounds.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_completed_table_title_cell.py now covers CSV_RERUN completed route chips with encode and oversized-encode remux fallback evidence.
